# NVIDIA signed Skill fixture

`mcore-linting-and-formatting/` and `nv-agent-root-cert.pem` are copied
unchanged from [NVIDIA/skills](https://github.com/NVIDIA/skills) at commit
`d8519c57da6db5d9bea274ec1724a4a7a56a3dee`, licensed under the Apache License
2.0. They are test data for certificate-chain OMS verification; the Skill is
not shipped.
